# v2.38-dev Release Notes

## Performance: fewer duplicate requests per page load

A small, behind-the-scenes tidy-up that trims redundant network calls the app was
making on every page load. **Nothing looks or behaves differently** — the same
data, just fetched once and shared instead of repeatedly.

### What changed

- **Region/country list is fetched once and cached.** The theatre / region /
  country list used by the student add & edit forms and by the report scope
  filters is now loaded a single time per session and shared across pages, rather
  than each page re-requesting it.
- **Single sign-in check per load.** The current-user lookup (`/api/auth/me`,
  which reads the database) was being requested twice on every protected page —
  once for the session/permissions and once for the date-format preference. Those
  two now share one request.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- No functional or visual changes — purely fewer duplicate requests and database
  reads per page load.
- Background polling was already conservative (idle-timeout keep-alive and the
  admin-only credential-health check are both capped at 5 minutes) and is left
  unchanged.

### Wrapping up

This completes the planned performance work (indexes & pooling, query batching,
short-lived caching, server-side aggregation + pagination for the heavy report
pages, and this concurrency-hygiene pass).
